evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet descriptor import logic in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
rationale: Allows importing public descriptors into a wallet that already has the required private keys without forcing the user to re-export and expose private keys over RPC. This resolves long-standing feature request #27336 ('Should be able to import an xpub descriptor to a privkey-enabled wallet if the wallet has the privkeys') and improves operational security for descriptor workflows.
